enp: A designer toy of a small girl, 2-head proportion. The focal point is that her whole silhouette has pixel-stepped edges and her surface shows individual cylindrical fuse beads, with one bead deliberately the wrong color and slightly crooked. Two square beads as eyes, a single horizontal-line mouth, two pink beads as blush, holding one bead in her hand. Low-saturation multicolor palette, matte bead-textured surface. Plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, full-body front view.

zh: 一个 2 头身的小女孩潮玩，最突出的是整个身体和头部的轮廓都是像素阶梯状的边缘，表面能看到一颗颗圆柱形的拼豆颗粒，其中一颗颜色故意不对、微微歪着。两颗方形豆子做眼睛，一条横线的嘴，两颗粉色豆子做腮红，手里捏着一颗豆子。低饱和的多彩配色，颗粒感哑光表面。纯浅灰背景，柔和棚拍光，正面全身构图。
